title: Laddu and Dadaji's Five-Senses Mela
moral: When we are patient and kind with our elders, everyone smiles.
description: It's Masti Mela day, but Dadaji can't find his glasses anywhere! So Laddu, Chintu, Pinky and Golu become his helpers and explore the fair with their senses: hearing the big drum, smelling hot jalebis, tasting, touching... and one very wiggly pillow. Learn the five senses in this funny animated story about respecting elders for kids aged 3 to 8.
outro: The End! Remember, friends: when we are patient and kind with our elders, everyone smiles. And Golu says... Ba-a-a-a! That means: please don't eat the glasses! See you tomorrow... bye-bye!

narration.text: Good morning, Masti Nagar! Today is the big Masti Mela, the happiest fair in town!
But Dadaji was looking everywhere. Under the charpai. Behind the tulsi pot. Even inside the teapot! Zip, zip, zip!

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: Arre! Where are my glasses? Without them, everything looks like one big fuzzy jalebi!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Fuzzy jalebi? Arre wah, jalebi time!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: IDEA! Dadaji, we will be your helpers today. We'll use ALL our senses!
Senses help us know the world. The first sense is seeing! We SEE with our eyes!

narration.text: So off they went to the mela, nice and slow, holding Dadaji's hand.
DHUM! DHUM! DHUM! What was that sound?

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: I know, I know! It's my tummy!
Hee hee! No, Laddu! It was the big red drum! Which part of our body helps us HEAR?
Our EARS! Ding! Super listening, friends!

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-a-a-a!
Golu danced to the drum... and bumped right into Laddu's bottom. BOING!

narration.text: The sweet shop uncle gave them the very last jalebi.

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Mine!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: No, mine!
Pull, pull, PULL! The jalebi stretched and stretched... and SNAP! Both boys sat down with a BUMP!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: Wait! This jalebi is for Dadaji. Elders first!

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: Mmm! Sweet and crunchy! We TASTE with our tongue! Ho ho HO!

narration.text: At the cloth stall, Dadaji wanted something soft for his pillow.
He couldn't see, so he used his hands to FEEL. We TOUCH with our skin!

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: This cloth is smooth. This mat is rough. And this pillow is... warm, fluffy and... wiggly?

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-a-a-a!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: Dadaji, that's not a pillow. That's Golu! And he's eating the pillow cover!

narration.text: By afternoon, Dadaji's legs felt tired. Laddu wanted to run to the giant wheel. Zoom!
But then he stopped. He came back. And he walked slowly, slowly, right beside Dadaji.

narration.speaker: pinky
narration.text: Leave it to Pinky! I'll find Dadaji a nice shady bench!
PHWEEEET! Pinky's whistle was so loud, three parrots flapped away in a fluttery tizzy!
Dadaji sat down by the bench... and in two seconds... Zzzzz.

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: I'm awake! I was just... resting my eyes!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: IDEA! Jalebi glasses! A slightly wobbly plan...
Chintu made glasses out of two round jalebis and popped them on Dadaji's nose.

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: Hmm... now everything looks sticky and orange!
And then... Golu gave Dadaji's turban a teeny-tiny nudge. Bump! Down slid... Dadaji's REAL glasses!
They were on top of his turban ALL along!
And Golu gobbled up the jalebi glasses. Munch, munch!

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: Ho ho HO! Now I can SEE you all!

narration.text: That night, the giant wheel twinkled with a hundred little lights.

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: Today you were my eyes and my ears. You walked slowly with me and shared with me. Thank you, my dears!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: You always take care of us, Dadaji. Today, we took care of you!
Round and round they went, all the way up to the stars. Wheeee!

narration.text: Let's remember! How many senses do we have? Count them on your fingers!
FIVE! We see, hear, smell, taste and touch! Ding!
And which part of our body helps us HEAR the big drum?

narration.speaker: pinky
narration.text: Our EARS! Wah, you remembered!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: And MY nose always finds Laddu. He smells of jalebis!

narration.text: Back home, Dadaji put his glasses safely on the charpai... not on his turban!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: My favourite sense is TASTE! Arre wah... jalebi time!

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-a-a-a!
And Golu? He wanted to TASTE Dadaji's glasses! No, Golu, NO! Hee hee hee!
